title: VidKit
description: A lightweight toolkit for video creators, optimizing Minecraft recording, replay, and editing.
body:
**VidKit** is a modular toolkit designed for Minecraft video creators.
It enhances your recording and replay workflow with intuitive tools, performance optimizations, and useful tweaks — all without unnecessary distractions.
[**This modpack is based on Fabulously Optimized (BSD-3-Clause)!!!**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized)

**Features include:**

_

Lightweight and easy to install

Optimized for high FPS recording

Replay enhancements and camera utilities

Configurable settings for every creator

_

**Perfect for YouTubers, streamers, and anyone looking to make Minecraft videos smoother and more professional.**

**This modpack is licensed under the MIT License for all original content and modifications by the author. Fabulously Optimized (BSD-3-Clause) is used as the base; their license and copyright notices are preserved. All included mods retain their original licenses. Please refer to each mod for specific licensing details.**
